functions.name: core_thread_start
functions.brief: Start Thread: bring up the radio and OpenThread, then join (or form) the network from config.json.

functions.name: core_thread_process
functions.brief: Run Thread: radio events, OpenThread timers and tasks, received datagrams.

functions.name: core_thread_role
functions.brief: The device's current Thread role.

functions.name: core_thread_on_role_change
functions.brief: Register a callback for role changes (detached, child, router, leader).

params.name: cb
params.description: Called with the new role from core_thread_process(); NULL to remove.

params.name: ctx
params.description: Passed back to cb; may be NULL.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_open
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_open(uint16_t port, core_thread_udp_rx_cb rx_cb, void * ctx)
functions.brief: Open a UDP socket bound to a port and receive datagrams sent to it.

params.name: rx_cb
params.description: Called for each datagram received on the port; may be NULL to only send.

params.name: ctx
params.description: Passed back to rx_cb; may be NULL.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_send
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_send(const uint8_t addr6[16], uint16_t port, const void * buf, uint16_t len)
functions.brief: Send a UDP datagram to an IPv6 address on the Thread network.

params.name: addr6
params.description: Destination IPv6 address, 16 bytes in network order.

functions.name: core_thread_udp_broadcast
functions.signature: core_thread_udp_broadcast(uint16_t port, const void * buf, uint16_t len)
functions.brief: Send a UDP datagram to every node on the Thread network (ff03::1, realm-local all-nodes).

functions.name: core_thread_rloc16
functions.brief: The device's RLOC16 (its short address in the mesh; changes with the role).

functions.name: core_thread_ext_addr
functions.brief: Copy the device's IEEE 802.15.4 extended address (8 bytes).

functions.name: core_thread_partition_id
functions.brief: The ID of the Thread partition the device belongs to.

functions.name: core_thread_neighbor_count
functions.brief: Number of neighbours in the device's neighbour table (routers and children it hears).

functions.name: core_thread_parent_rssi
functions.brief: Average RSSI of frames from the parent, when the device is a child.

functions.name: core_thread_last_error
functions.brief: The last error OpenThread reported to this API (an otError value; 0 = none).

functions.name: core_thread_instance
functions.brief: The OpenThread instance, for C code that calls the OpenThread API directly.

functions.name: core_thread_get_network
functions.brief: Read the network the device is set to (its active dataset), without the network key.

params.name: out
params.description: Receives channel, PAN ID, ext PAN ID, mesh-local prefix, name and timestamp; network_key is all zeros.

functions.name: core_thread_set_enabled
functions.brief: Stop or restart Thread: leave the network (detach, radio idle for Thread) or attach again.

params.name: on
params.description: 0 to stop (the role becomes CORE_THREAD_DISABLED), 1 to start again.

functions.name: core_thread_set_dataset
functions.brief: Move the device to another Thread network and store it, so it wins over config.json from now on.

params.name: ds
params.description: The new network: channel 11-26, PAN ID 0x0000-0xFFFE, a 1-16 byte name, key, ext PAN ID, mesh-local prefix.

functions.name: core_thread_factory_reset
functions.brief: Forget the stored (provisioned) network and return to config.json's, then attach again.

functions.name: core_thread_is_provisioned
functions.brief: Is the current network a stored (provisioned) one rather than config.json's factory default?

functions.name: core_thread_prov_allow_write
functions.brief: Hook: may a BLE client change the network now? Override to gate the provisioning service.
